sections.text:
```json
[
  {
    "severity": "Major",
    "confidence": "confirmed",
    "location": "packages/aicore/lib/aicore/content/eval.py:566",
    "failure_scenario": "A valid evals.json or pressure.json that contains a non-integer JSON number (assertion value 1.5, or 1.0) passes validate_evals. cmd_eval still runs every case, then skill_eval_context calls digest_json on the parsed {evals, pressure} object. digest_json raises TypeError, so benchmark.json is never written (the write is quality/eval.py:220, after the context assignment at line 214). The same call at content/eval.py:965 makes build_system_benchmark raise on a bank document that only adds a float outcome field the graders ignore; system-bank-benchmark/v1 returned that benchmark.",
    "basis": "correctness | reproduction: PYTHONPATH=packages/aicore/lib python3 -c 'import json,tempfile; from pathlib import Path; from aicore.content import eval as ev; from aicore.tests.content import test_eval_context as t' 2>/dev/null; direct snippet: validate_evals([]) is [] for {\"skill\":\"demo\",\"cases\":[{\"id\":1,\"prompt\":\"p\",\"assertions\":[{\"type\":\"contains\",\"value\":1.5}]}]}, then skill_eval_context raises TypeError: canonical JSON values must not use floats. build_system_benchmark on the system-reliability fixture with outcome.score=0.5 raises the same TypeError."
  },
  {
    "severity": "Minor",
    "confidence": "confirmed",
    "location": "packages/aicore/lib/aicore/content/eval.py:544",
    "failure_scenario": "eval_context accepts runner.models with duplicate names and returns that list. The published eval-context/v1 schema sets uniqueItems on runner.models, so schema.validate rejects the object the constructor just built. build_system_benchmark stores a caller-supplied runner without deduplicating, so the benchmark context can be schema-invalid. runner_context itself dedupes, and cmd_eval goes through it.",
    "basis": "correctness | reproduction: PYTHONPATH=packages/aicore/lib python3 snippet: ev.eval_context(..., runner={provider: claude-code, cli_version: None, models: [\"m\",\"m\"]}) returns models ['m','m']; schema.validate reports ('unique', '/runner/models: items 0 and 1 are equal')."
  },
  {
    "severity": "Minor",
    "confidence": "confirmed",
    "location": "packages/aicore/lib/aicore/content/eval.py:496",
    "failure_scenario": "runner_context turns a missing binary, a non-zero exit, and a timeout into cli_version null. A --version probe whose stdout is not decodable in the process locale raises UnicodeDecodeError from subprocess.run(text=True) before that handler. cmd_eval calls runner_context after the runs, so the exception aborts the command and skips benchmark.json.",
    "basis": "correctness | reproduction: Fake executable writes b'\\xff\\xfe' to stdout and exits 0. ev.runner_context(path, []) raises UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xff in position 0: invalid start byte. A sleep probe with VERSION_PROBE_TIMEOUT=0.2 returns cli_version null in 0.202s."
  }
]
```
